coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .gitignore due to an API error (HTTP 400)
learnings: Handle LLM API errors gracefully without failing the entire package audit if the failed file is non-executable (like .gitignore).
Implement retry logic for transient API errors to prevent inconclusive verdicts on benign files.
